hook_line: DHURANDHAR SWEEPS DPIFF AWARDS 2026 AS TAYLOR SWIFT, JAMES CAMERON TAKE GLOBAL HONOURS

hook_stat.sub: Categories at the DPIFF Awards 2026, announced in Mumbai on November 20, 2026

news_summary: The Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Festival (DPIFF) announced its 2026 winners on November 20, 2026, in Mumbai, across 41 categories. Dhurandhar led the Indian film honours — Best Film, Best Actor for Ranveer Singh, Best Director for Aditya Dhar, Best Actor in a Negative Role for Akshaye Khanna and Best Music Director for Shashwat Sachdev — while Taylor Swift was named International Artist of the Year and James Cameron was honoured for Outstanding Contribution in Global Cinema.
payoff: DPIFF is a privately organised festival, not the Government of India's Dadasaheb Phalke Award — its 2026 list is one private festival's picks, with a strong year for Dhurandhar, Saiyaara and Kantara: Chapter 1.
